page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.6xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by the KVM hypervisor on the x86_64 architecture. The server is configured with an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, delivering 24 vCPUs across 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Memory capacity is 93.0 GB of system RAM, providing approximately 3.88 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Turing T4 GPU equipped with 16 GB of VRAM. The instance includes an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile and contains no local storage, requiring network-attached block storage volumes for persistent data.

Benchmark testing illustrates strong contrast between CPU and GPU performance tiers. Single-threaded performance on the Intel Xeon 8163 is limited, with the Geekbench single-core score of 935.0 falling in the bottom 10% tier and a single-thread gzip compression speed of 19.22 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-threaded throughput achieves mid-range levels, reflected in a Geekbench multi-core result of 7397.0 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 82.88 GB/sec. Memory subsystem testing demonstrates 95.33 GB/sec large-block read bandwidth and 46.95 GB/sec write bandwidth, matching average expectations for this platform class.

The bundled NVIDIA T4 accelerator delivers significant inference performance for compact models. Large language model evaluation demonstrates prompt processing speeds of 8377.38 tokens/sec on 135M parameter models and 1130.26 tokens/sec on 7B parameter models, ranking both in the top 10% tier. Text generation reaches 33.05 tokens/sec for 7B models, placing in the top 25% bracket. Due to the 16 GB VRAM ceiling, large 70B parameter models are unsupported. The architecture presents an efficient operational profile for small-to-medium deep learning inference, image processing, ray tracing tasks, and general GPU-assisted microservices without the overhead of enterprise-scale training accelerators.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.6xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server built on the x86_64 architecture, combining 24 vCPUs (12 physical cores) from an Intel Xeon 8163 processor at 2.5 GHz with 93.0 GB of system memory. It is equipped with a dedicated NVIDIA Turing T4 GPU containing 16 GB of VRAM and an 8 Gbps baseline network interface, while requiring external network storage due to the absence of bundled local disks. Benchmark evaluation highlights moderate multi-core CPU capacity alongside weaker single-core processing. However, the hardware accelerator achieves top-tier prompt processing throughput in machine learning benchmarks for smaller models, reaching 1130.26 tokens/sec on 7B architectures. Given its memory profile and dedicated accelerator, the instance is well suited for deep learning inference, model evaluation, image processing, and media-processing pipelines.
